dedupe_keys.name: field pump and water demand measurements from the water distribution system of igoumenitsa greece

description: The Igoumenitsa water-network depositor publishes field pump and demand measurements from Greece. Zenodo supplies two MATLAB files and a text dictionary free under CC BY 4.0. One array has flow and electrical power observations for twelve variable-speed pumps at different input frequencies, with a quadratic fitted-power value. The second contains ninety-six fifteen-minute water-demand steps from five aggregated points on 2 August 2024. These data can calibrate pumping energy and daily demand in distribution-network simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this measured network package. Coverage is one utility and a single documented demand day; seasonality and exceptional operation cannot be inferred. The pump fitting is a model estimate alongside measurements, and field uncertainty is not specified. No MATLAB data was downloaded or fitted curve checked.
